`com.jcabi:jcabi-aspects` from `0.24.1` to `0.25.1` (minor update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/jcabi/jcabi-github/pull/1642

## Your Task

The source code is in `/jcabi-github`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll start by understanding the compilation errors and then fix them.
